title: Next.js Indic Translator
description: Full Next.js 15 (App Router) app with a translator UI: paste text, pick a target language, hit translate. Server-side API route calls Sarvam's /translate. Tailwind-free, vanilla CSS, ready to deploy on Vercel.

options.PROJECT_NAME: App + package name. Defaults to target dir name.
options.DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG: Default target BCP-47 code. Default: hi-IN.

next_steps: npm install   (or pnpm install / bun install)
